messages.content: ترجم كل وحدة إنجليزية إلى العربية الفصحى بدقة واكتمال، مع حفظ المعنى والأسماء والإشارات الكتابية. لا تضف أسماء أو معلومات غير موجودة في النص، ولا تكتب ملاحظات أو شروحاً. أخرج JSON مطابقاً للمخطط فقط. يجب أن تكون chapter وverse عددين صحيحين بأرقام 0-9، وأن يكون text_ar ترجمة الوحدة وحدها.

{"chapter":3,"verses":[{"chapter":3,"verse":16,"text":"And the surplus of our profit we may give as help to the poor, and then shaII we return to thee thine own (money)."},{"chapter":3,"verse":17,"text":"And when I heard this, I was glad that they should take this altogether from me for the husbandry of charity for the poor."},{"chapter":3,"verse":18,"text":"And with a willing heart I gave them what they wanted, and I accepted their written bond, but would not take any other security from them except the written document."},{"chapter":3,"verse":19,"text":"And they went abroad and gave to time poor as far as they were successful."},{"chapter":3,"verse":20,"text":"Frequently, however, some of their goods were lost on the road or on the sea, or they would he robbed of them."}],"book_code":"TJOB"}

response_format: JSON schema with book_code and verses. Each item has integer chapter, integer verse, and Arabic text_ar. Return exactly source verse numbers 16,17,18,19,20 in this chapter.
